faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in White Rock: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 1 bedroom condos sell for in White Rock?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in White Rock, 37 sold over the past year at a median of $429,000, with the middle half between $334,000 and $525,000.

faq.q: How fast do 1 bedroom condos sell in White Rock?
faq.a: The median was 41 days, and homes sold for 96.8% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in White Rock do most 1 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: White Rock, with 37 of the 37 sales at a median of $429,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in White Rock have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Pacific Pointe (4 sales); Miramar Village (3 sales); Beachborough (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in White Rock?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in White Rock was $418 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in White Rock compare
A 1 bedroom condo in White Rock sold for $161,000 less at the median than a 2 bedroom one ($429,000 against $590,000, 177 sales). The strata fee was $418 a month against $575.
Of the 7 cities with 1 bedroom condo pages, White Rock has the second highest median price. Abbotsford is lowest at $324,950 and South Surrey highest at $485,000.
